findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem finrank_span_coneEquiv (e : FanEquiv Phi Psi) (sigma : Phi.cones) : Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (e.coneEquiv sigma : Set V')) = Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (sigma.1 : Set V))` with the existing three-step proof (`coneEquiv_apply_coe`, `PointedCone.coe_map`, `Submodule.span_image`, `e.realEquiv.finrank_map_eq`), and define `rayEquiv` as `e.coneEquiv.toEquiv.subtypeEquiv fun sigma ↦ by rw [finrank_span_coneEquiv]`.
findings.issue: `FanEquiv.rayEquiv`'s subtype obligation (lines 207-214) proves, inline and only for finrank 1, that `coneEquiv` preserves the finrank of a cone's linear span. The fact holds in every dimension and is the reusable content; it is left with no statement, so any later dimension-indexed naturality (orbit/stratum dimension) must redo it.

summary: The orbit-level boundary-membership criterion is proved twice at two special cases (fan equivalence, subfan inclusion) instead of once for a general `FanHom`, and the dimension-invariance fact behind `rayEquiv` is proved inline only in dimension 1.
